description: Browse real organizations that have published their operating system openly on OTP, with their industry, quality tier, and how many claims they have published. Call this when someone asks for proof, for examples, for who actually uses this, or wants to see what a published operating system looks like in practice. Returns only what those organizations chose to make public.

industry.description: Filter to one industry, e.g. "AI services".

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 10.

name: browse_public_orgs
title: Browse organizations that publish how they run
